subject: Recognition readiness: slate & PO lanes for July bookings
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sally R. <sally.r@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recognition readiness: slate & PO lanes for July bookings

Sally —

Following up on our Q3 bookings schedule: we have a cluster of ACME orders (see attached slate) that need to be in the PO/invoice window to hit July bookings recognition. To avoid last-minute gaps on our side, can you confirm: (1) expected PO issuance date(s) per line in the attached recognition_slate.xlsx, (2) whether ACME can accept partial invoices before PO finalization, and (3) the procurement contact who will actually submit the PO (we'll follow up with them directly).

We'd like to run a short commit review on Friday to lock recognition decisions — if we don't have PO arrival dates by EOD Thursday we'll need to decide fallback treatment (defer recognition / mark as contingent).

Attachments: recognition_slate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Sally R. <sally.r@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement-accts@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 12:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recognition readiness: slate & PO lanes for July bookings

Karthik —

Thanks for the slate. Quick update from procurement: internal approvals are in flight; we expect to issue POs for the majority of the lines on 2028-07-25. A small subset (three projects) are on an extended legal review and are likely to slip into the next week.

On partial invoices: yes, ACME can accept pre-PO invoices for milestone-based work if we mark them as "pending PO" on your side; we'll also send the PO acknowledgement once the PO is live. I'll loop in procurement-accts so they see the line-level sheet.

Procurement contact for PO submission: procurement-accts@acmehealth.com (cc'd).

Sally R.
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
Attachment: acme_po_template.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recognition readiness: slate & PO lanes for July bookings

Karthik / Ben —

Two operational points from Finance before we confirm the commit review ask list: (1) our invoice cutoff for July recognition is 2028-07-31 23:59 PT. To recognize, we need either (a) PO issued by supplier + invoice received and matched to the PO by that cutoff, or (b) invoice + documented procurement acknowledgement allowing accrual. (2) If ACME sends "pending PO" invoices, Revenue Ops needs a stamped acknowledgment or email thread from their procurement team referencing the related PO line so we can accrue.

For the three items Sally flagged as legal-hold, we should mark them as "contingent — external approvals" in the commit review and exclude them from the committed forecast until we have either PO or invoice+ack. I'll attach a short commit_review_notes.md with the template I'll use Friday.

Action: Ben, can you confirm whether our current SOW permits milestone billing for the affected items (so we can accept partial invoices)?

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recognition readiness: slate & PO lanes for July bookings

Marissa / team —

Checked the executed SOW: milestone billing is allowed for two of the three legal-hold projects, with defined deliverables. The third project is time-and-materials only, so partial invoices would be a stretch without an amendment. I'll coordinate with legal to see if we can get a narrow amendment approved quickly; I expect an update by EOD Thursday.

If legal can't approve by Thursday, recommend we mark that single line as deferred in the forecast and present two scenarios in Friday's commit review: (A) optimistic — includes milestone invoices (if amendment arrives), (B) conservative — excludes the T&M line.

Ben
Senior Account Executive

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sally R. <sally.r@acmehealth.com>, procurement-accts@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recognition readiness: slate & PO lanes for July bookings — Friday commit review agenda

Team / ACME —

Thanks for the quick responses. Final agenda for Friday's 30-minute commit review (09:00 PT):

1) Review recognition_slate.xlsx line by line and confirm PO arrival windows (Sally / procurement-accts)
2) Decide on treatment for the three legal-hold items (Marissa to present contingent vs committed scenarios)
3) Confirm whether ACME will issue partial invoices and provide the required procurement acknowledgment format (Sally)
4) Agree on final committed amount to publish in the forecast by EOD Friday (Karthik / Vivek)

Pre-reads: recognition_slate.xlsx, acme_po_template.pdf, commit_review_notes.md (attached). Please flag any items that absolutely cannot be discussed live (legal hold or NDA constraints).

If we have PO arrival confirmations for the majority of lines by Thursday EOD, we will treat those as committed and include them in July recognition; otherwise default to conservative scenario.

Thanks — see you Friday.

Karthik
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: recognition_slate.xlsx, commit_review_notes.md
